Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time




Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Indicative range: $100,000 – $160,000 (USD equivalent), plus benefits.




Role Overview

We are hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build features end-to-end across our web application. The role spans frontend, backend, and the database underneath — partnering with product and design to ship things that work and scale.




Key Responsibilities

- Build user-facing features end-to-end, from UI through API to database

- Write clean, maintainable code with appropriate test coverage

job.description:
Action1 is an autonomous patch management platform trusted by many Fortune 500 companies. Cloud-native, infinitely scalable, highly secure, and configurable in 5 minutes, it just works and is always free for the first 200 endpoints, with no functional limits. By pioneering autonomous OS and third-party application patching, Action1 helps organizations eliminate routine work, reduce ransomware and security risks, and protect the digital employee experience. It provides real-time vulnerability assessment and remediation across remote and on-site endpoints without requiring a VPN, while peer-to-peer patch distribution reduces bandwidth use on local networks.

In 2026, Action1 was recognized as the fastest-growing founder-led cybersecurity company in America on the Inc. 5000. Action1 is led by industry veterans Alex Vovk and Mike Walters, American entrepreneurs who founded Netwrix, which has grown into an industry-leading, multibillion-dollar cybersecurity company.

We are looking for a Dev Manager to lead the engineering team responsible for integrations between our product and external systems, including the Integrations Store. You will combine engineering leadership with hands-on technical expertise to deliver secure, reliable integrations that fit our customers' workflows.

Lead and develop a team of engineers, providing technical direction, mentoring, and regular feedback

Guide technical decisions within the assigned domain from solution design through development and production rollout, coordinating cross-cutting architecture and security decisions with their designated owners
Establish reusable integration patterns that handle retries, rate limits, duplicate events, and API version changes reliably
Own automated pipelines for building, testing, validating, and deploying integrations
Improve integration reliability, performance, and observability, and guide the team in resolving production issues
Coordinate with other engineering teams and external partners to manage dependencies and compatibility
Apply AI technologies where they improve integration development, testing, or support, with appropriate validation of outputs


Requirements

job.title: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer, AI & Search (India)
job.description:
Who We Are

Yieldmo is an advertising platform that helps brands invent creative experiences through tech and AI, using custom ad formats, proprietary attention signals, predictive format selection, and privacy-safe premium inventory curation. We believe all ads should be human-centered, tailored, and provoke emotion and action. Yieldmo helps brands deliver the best ad for every impression opportunity, merging creative and media for proven results.

The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (5–10 years of experience) to help build Yieldmo's AI-powered search engine, which will change how users discover and engage with content across major publishers. This is a full-stack role with a strong ML component. You'll build backend services and ML-powered features, and ship the user-facing interfaces that bring them to life. We care most about builders: engineers who write production code, iterate quickly, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and own their work end to end.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that power AI-driven search, including retrieval, ranking, and indexing components.
Build and deploy ML features into production: embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and model evaluation.
Develop responsive, performant front-end experiences that surface search results and AI features to users and internal teams.
Build and maintain data and content ingestion pipelines that feed the search system.
Own features end to end, from prototype through production, monitoring, and iteration.
Partner with Product, ML, and Engineering teams to turn requirements into shipped features.
Drive quality, performance, and reliability for the services you own, including testing, code reviews, and observability.
Share knowledge and support teammates; senior engineers will mentor others and contribute to technical design decisions.


Requirements


Must be based in India.
5–10 years of professional software engineering experience, building and operating production systems.
Strong backend skills in Python, with solid SQL and experience designing APIs and microservices.
Hands-on front-end experience with a modern framework (React preferred) plus JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Practical ML experience in production: working with embeddings, vector databases, LLMs, RAG, or ranking/recommendation models.
Experience with Docker, cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), and CI/CD.
Strong fundamentals in data structures, system design, and testing.
Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working cross-functionally in a fast-moving, remote team.
An ownership mindset: you ship, measure, and improve.


Nice to Haves


Deeper ML/AI backend experience: model serving, fine-tuning, training pipelines, or online/offline evaluation.
Experience building search or retrieval systems (inverted indexes, BM25, hybrid search, rerankers).
Familiarity with data tools such as Kafka, Spark, Airflow, or a modern data warehouse.
Experience with publisher-scale content, recommendation systems, or adtech.


Hiring Process

Selected candidates will be invited to a 30-minute screening call with our Talent Acquisition team, where we'll share full process details. The process typically includes:


A 30-minute video interview with the Hiring Manager.
A remote round of video interviews with team members and leadership.
An offer for successful candidates.


Our Values


Innovation: We encourage curiosity, embrace new ideas, and believe no idea is too bold.
Agility: We embrace change, act quickly, and adapt with a focus on getting things done.
Intelligence: We make decisions guided by data, aiming to deliver maximum value to our customers.
Autonomy: We empower individuals to create their own paths with flexibility and independence.
Togetherness: We foster teamwork, mutual support, and an environment where every voice matters.


What We Offer


Remote work: A fully distributed team, with annual offsites, holiday parties, and more.
Company-paid health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family.
Equity: Share in Yieldmo's success through our employee stock option program.
Flexible time off: Plus company slowdowns and Summer Fridays.
Home office setup and stipend: Premium technology packages and a stipend for extra needs.
Professional development: An annual stipend to grow your hard and soft skills.

Action1 is an autonomous patch management platform trusted by many Fortune 500 companies. Cloud-native, infinitely scalable, highly secure, and configurable in 5 minutes, it just works and is always free for the first 200 endpoints, with no functional limits. By pioneering autonomous OS and third-party application patching, Action1 helps organizations eliminate routine work, reduce ransomware and security risks, and protect the digital employee experience. It provides real-time vulnerability assessment and remediation across remote and on-site endpoints without requiring a VPN, while peer-to-peer patch distribution reduces bandwidth use on local networks.

In 2026, Action1 was recognized as the fastest-growing founder-led cybersecurity company in America on the Inc. 5000. Action1 is led by industry veterans Alex Vovk and Mike Walters, American entrepreneurs who founded Netwrix, which has grown into an industry-leading, multibillion-dollar cybersecurity company.

We are looking for a Dev Manager to lead the engineering team responsible for Executive Reporting.

You will combine engineering leadership with hands-on technical expertise to help customers understand patching and vulnerability trends over time through reliable reports and dashboards.

What you'll do:


Lead and develop a team of engineers, providing technical direction, mentoring, and regular feedback. 
Own delivery outcomes within the agreed scope, provide practical estimates, and make capacity and priority trade-offs visible. 
 Work with Product Management and the EVP to define priorities and translate customer needs into executive reporting capabilities. 
 Oversee the design, development, and operation of reporting capabilities, including: 
 Historical reporting on patches and vulnerabilities
 The Enterprise Reports Engine and reusable report execution capabilities
 Dashboard services for presenting trends and status to decision-makers
 Data aggregation and consistent calculation of reporting metrics
 Report generation, scheduling, and export workflows
 Guide technical decisions within the assigned domain, from solution design through development and production rollout, while coordinating cross-cutting architecture and security decisions with their designated owners. 
 Establish clear definitions for metrics, reporting periods, data freshness, and missing data so customers can interpret results accurately. 
 Coordinate with Product Value and core engineering teams on source data, reporting content, access controls, and shared infrastructure. 
 Own automated pipelines for building, testing, validating, and deploying reporting services. 
 Improve reporting accuracy, query performance, reliability, and observability as customer data volumes grow. 
 Apply AI technologies where they improve reporting development, validation, or interpretation


Requirements

What we're looking for:


 Experience leading software engineers and owning the delivery and operation of production systems. 
 Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to contribute to technical problem-solving. 
 Excellent knowledge of Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript. 
 Experience building and operating AWS services in production. 
 Hands-on experience with reporting platforms, analytics services, or data-intensive applications. 
 Proficiency in SQL and experience with data modeling, aggregation, and query performance. 
 Understanding of historical data, metric consistency, and data-quality validation. 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to align engineering work with product priorities. 
 Professional working proficiency in English for leading an English-speaking team and collaborating across functions


Nice to have:


Experience writing automated tests for data pipelines, reporting calculations, and report generation. 
 Experience with dashboard engines, scheduled reporting, and large data exports. 
 Experience with patch management or vulnerability reporting. 
 Experience with runtime isolation and sandboxing for sensitive execution. 
 Experience in B2B SaaS, security, compliance, or data governance. 
 Experience building high-load products that support large numbers of endpoints


Benefits


Fully remote work with flexibility to support your work-life balance. 
 A collaborative environment that empowers you to own your domain and implement best practices. 
 Stable income, benefits, flexible working hours, and opportunities for career advancement. 
 Friendly, professional colleagues who are eager to support you and help you grow. 
 Engaging challenges and opportunities to make a meaningful impact

job.title: Senior Platform Engineer with GO
job.description:
Who are we

DXC Luxoft is a global IT services and consulting company, part of DXC Technology, delivering cutting-edge digital and software solutions worldwide. We partner with leading financial institutions and global enterprises, helping them transform and scale through modern technology.




Join a global community of engineers and be part of building impactful, modern technology solutions!




Project Description:

We're building a Cloud Observability platform for market leading large Germany based company with 440,000 customers worldwide.

Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, the company has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end enterprise application software, database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. A top cloud company with 200 million users worldwide, the company helps businesses of all sizes and in all industries to operate profitably, adapt continuously, and achieve their purpose.




Responsibilities:

• Lead sprint-based feature development for routing and collector-as-a-service platforms

• Develop Kubernetes operators using controller-runtime / Operator SDK (kubebuilder)

• Design and implement CRDs & Admission Webhooks

• Build custom OpenTelemetry Collector distributions and exporters

• Develop frontend components using React / TypeScript / Tailwind / Vite / TanStack

• Implement and maintain Istio service mesh and mTLS/OIDC/JWT security

• Integrate with Open Service Broker / Cloud Broker APIs and enterprise platform services

• Maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD

• Contribute to architecture decisions and create ADRs for major changes

• Participate in developer on-call rotation outside core hours




Mandatory Skills Description:

• Go language development

• Node.js / TypeScript development

• Kubernetes container orchestration

• OpenTelemetry (OTEL) observability

• controller-runtime / Operator SDK (kubebuilder)

• CRDs & Admission Webhooks

• GitHub Actions and ArgoCD CI/CD

• Kustomize configuration management

• Istio / Service Mesh infrastructure

• mTLS / OIDC / JWT / OAuth2 security

• PostgreSQL and Kafka

• ModelContext Protocol (MCP) AI framework

• React / Frontend Stack (TS, Tailwind, Vite, TanStack)

• Open Service Broker / Cloud Broker APIs




Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• OTEL Collector custom distributions and exporters

• gRPC networking

• Gardener cluster lifecycle management

• GCP / Azure / AWS cloud platforms

• Prometheus / Grafana / Jaeger / Splunk monitoring

• Enterprise platform integration (BTP or similar)

• AI-assisted / spec-driven development practices

• NATS messaging, Helm, HashiCorp Vault, Kyverno, HAProxy

• Sovereign / Air-gapped architecture

• Cost Management & FinOps
